display_long_description:
🐒 Monkian

A Movement-Based Multiplayer Game with Multiple Modes and Maps

Monkian is a fast-paced multiplayer game built around smooth, skill-based movement and creative map design. Players use momentum, climbing, and precise control to move through a wide variety of environments, mastering routes, shortcuts, and techniques as they play. Whether you’re racing across open spaces, experimenting with movement tech, or just hanging out with others, Monkian rewards practice and creativity.

At its core, Monkian is about freedom of movement. Every jump, climb, and turn matters. The more you play, the better you become at reading maps, chaining movements together, and finding faster or more efficient paths. The game is easy to pick up but hard to master, making every session feel fresh and rewarding.

🗺️ Maps & Environments

Monkian features a growing collection of unique maps, each designed with different themes, layouts, and gameplay goals. Some maps are large and open, allowing players to move at high speed and experiment with advanced movement techniques. Others are tighter and more complex, focusing on precision, timing, and careful navigation.

Maps are not just visual changes—they affect how you play. Vertical spaces, hidden routes, interactive elements, and secret areas encourage exploration and replayability. Learning a map’s layout is just as important as mastering movement itself.

🎮 Game Modes

Monkian offers multiple game modes
